5868-nothing-to-eat.title: Nothing To Eat
5868-nothing-to-eat.creator: Horatio Alger and Thomas Chandler Haliburton
5868-nothing-to-eat.description: A book by Horatio Alger and Thomas Chandler Haliburton. The every-day cry and the every-day fare,  That's every day heard where the Livewells are dining,  Is nothing to eat, or else nothing to wear,  Which naked and starving rich Merdles are whining.

arxiv-1704-01346.title: CompiLIG at SemEval-2017 Task 1: Cross-Language Plagiarism Detection Methods for Semantic Textual Similarity
arxiv-1704-01346.creator: Jérémy Ferrero, Frédéric Agnès, Laurent Besacier, Didier Schwab
arxiv-1704-01346.description: Abstract We present our submitted systems for Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) Track 4 at SemEval-2017. Given a pair of Spanish-English sentences, each system must estimate their semantic similarity by a score between 0 and 5. In our submission, we use syntax-based, dictionary-based, context-based, and MT-based methods. We also combine these methods in unsupervised and supervised way.

arxiv-2201-03965.title: On the Efficacy of Co-Attention Transformer Layers in Visual Question Answering
arxiv-2201-03965.creator: Ankur Sikarwar, Gabriel Kreiman
arxiv-2201-03965.description: Abstract In recent years, multi-modal transformers have shown significant progress in Vision-Language tasks, such as Visual Question Answering (VQA), outperforming previous architectures by a considerable margin. This improvement in VQA is often attributed to the rich interactions between vision and language streams.

arxiv-2307-00123.title: How Do Human Users Teach a Continual Learning Robot in Repeated Interactions?
arxiv-2307-00123.creator: Ali Ayub, Jainish Mehta, Zachary De Francesco, Patrick Holthaus, Kerstin Dautenhahn, and Chrystopher L. Nehaniv
arxiv-2307-00123.description: Abstract Continual learning (CL) has emerged as an important avenue of research in recent years, at the intersection of Machine Learning (ML) and Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), to allow robots to continually learn in their environments over long-term interactions with humans.

arxiv-2406-04873.title: Ada-VE: Training-Free Consistent Video Editing Using Adaptive Motion Prior
arxiv-2406-04873.creator: Tanvir Mahmud, Mustafa Munir, Radu Marculescu, Diana Marculescu
arxiv-2406-04873.description: Abstract Video-to-video synthesis poses significant challenges in maintaining character consistency, smooth temporal transitions, and preserving visual quality during fast motion. While recent fully cross-frame self-attention mechanisms have improved character consistency across multiple frames, they come with high computational costs and often include redundant operations, especially for videos with higher frame rates.

arxiv-2412-04100.title: Missing Melodies: AI Music Generation and its "Nearly" Complete Omission of the Global South
arxiv-2412-04100.creator: Atharva Mehta, Shivam Chauhan, Monojit Choudhury
arxiv-2412-04100.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Atharva Mehta, Shivam Chauhan, Monojit Choudhury. Recent advances in generative AI have sparked renewed interest and expanded possibilities for music generation. However, the performance and versatility of these systems across musical genres are heavily influenced by the availability of training data.

arxiv-2503-10388.title: Reexamining Circular Dichroism in Photoemission From a Topological Insulator
arxiv-2503-10388.creator: Ittai Sidilkover, Yun Yen, Sunil Wilfred D’Souza, Jakub Schusser, Aki Pulkkinen, Costel R. Rotundu, Makoto Hashimoto, Donghui Liu, Zhi-Xun Shen, Ján Minár, Michael Schüler, Hadas Soifer, Jonathan A. Sobota
arxiv-2503-10388.description: Abstract The orbital angular momentum (OAM) of electron states is an essential ingredient for topological and quantum geometric quantities in solids. For example, Dirac surface states with helical spin- and orbital-angular momenta are a hallmark of a 3D topological insulator.

britannica-1911-palmer.title: Palmer (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-palmer.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-palmer.description: Article 'Palmer' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. pilgrimage to Palestine carried a palm-branch attached to his staff, or more frequently a cross made of two strips of palm-leaf fastened to his hat. The word is frequently used as synonymous with “pilgrim” (see Pilgrimage). The name “palmer” or “palmer-worm” is often given to many kinds of hairy caterpillars, specifically to that of the destructive tineid moth, Ypsilophus pometella.

pmc-11358988.title: Sensing with Molecularly Imprinted Membranes on Two-Dimensional Solid-Supported Substrates
pmc-11358988.creator: Lishuang Wang, Nan Li, Xiaoyan Zhang, Ivan Bobrinetskiy, Ivana Gadjanski, Wangyang Fu
pmc-11358988.description: Molecularly imprinted membranes (MIMs) have been a focal research interest since 1990, representing a breakthrough in the integration of target molecules into membrane structures for cutting-edge sensing applications. This paper traces the developmental history of MIMs, elucidating the diverse methodologies employed in their preparation and characterization on two-dimensional solid-supported substrates.

pmc-11435566.title: Reliability, Objectivity, Validity, and Reference Levels of the Austrian Pole Climbing Test (APCT)—A Novel Monitoring Tool for Assessing General Fitness in Children, Adolescents, and Young Adults
pmc-11435566.creator: Gerald Jarnig, Reinhold Kerbl, Mireille N. M. van Poppel
pmc-11435566.description: Climbing is an activity involving many major muscle groups and, therefore, it is suitable for assessing general physical fitness. The Austrian pole climbing test (APCT) was developed as a reliable and valid test for the assessment of general fitness levels in children, adolescents, and young adults.

pmc-11509452.title: One-Year Effect of Elexacaftor/Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor Therapy on HbA1c Levels and Insulin Requirement in Patients with Insulin-Dependent Cystic Fibrosis-Related Diabetes: A Retrospective Observational Study
pmc-11509452.creator: Marta Bassi, Marina Francesca Strati, Gaia Spiandorello, Marta Scalas, Federico Cresta, Maria Grazia Calevo, Giuseppe d’Annunzio, Carlo Castellani, Nicola Minuto, Mohamad Maghnie, Rosaria Casciaro
pmc-11509452.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: The impact of ETI therapy on pulmonary function and nutritional status has been widely studied; the literature on the possible outcomes on glycemic control and insulin requirement in patients affected by CFRD is controversial. Aim: The main objective of our study was to evaluate HbA1c levels in patients with cystic fibrosis-related diabetes (CFRD) after one year of therapy with elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI).

pmc-11589346.title: Assessment of Y-90 Radioembolization Treatment Response for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cases Using MRI Radiomics
pmc-11589346.creator: Mennaallah Mahmoud, Ko-Han Lin, Rheun-Chuan Lee, Chien-an Liu
pmc-11589346.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to investigate the ability of radiomics features extracted from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) images to differentiate between responders and non-responders for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cases who received Y-90 transarterial radioembolization treatment.MethodsThirty-six cases of HCC who underwent MRI scans after Y-90 radioembolization were included in this study.

pmc-11643561.title: Development of a Detailed Chemical Kinetic Model for 1-Methylnaphthalene
pmc-11643561.creator: Junjie Liang, Qianlong Zhang, Yijun Heng, Gesheng Li, Ke Yang, Ruiyang Wang, Fan Dong, Neng Zhu, Danila Barskiy
pmc-11643561.description: 1-Methylnaphthalene is a critical component for constructing fuel surrogates of diesel and aviation kerosene. However, the reaction pathways of 1-methylnaphthalene included in existing detailed chemical kinetic models vary from each other, leading to discrepancies in the simulation of ignition and oxidation processes.

pmc-11811911.title: Very high-energy gamma-ray emission beyond 10 TeV from GRB 221009A
pmc-11811911.creator: The LHAASO Collaboration
pmc-11811911.description: The highest-energy gamma-rays from gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) have important implications for their radiation mechanism. Here we report the detection of gamma-rays up to 13 teraelectronvolts from the brightest GRB 221009A by the Large High Altitude Air-shower Observatory (LHAASO). The LHAASO-KM2A detector registered more than 140 gamma-rays with energies above 3 teraelectronvolts during 230 to 900 seconds after the trigger.

pmc-12613440.title: A novel pregabalin functionalized salicylaldehyde derivative loaded mesoporous silica nano scaffold: a prospective carrier for targeting inflammatory cytokine storm
pmc-12613440.creator: Yasir Mehmood, Syeda Momena Rizvi, Musarrat Ijaz, Tamseela Shahzadi, Hira Shahid, Shabbir Ahmed, Akhtar Rasul, Javed Iqbal, Abdulrahman A Almehizia, Amir Bouallegue, Musaab Dauelbait, Esmael M Alyami
pmc-12613440.description: Active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) have poor efficacy and low bloodstream and target site concentrations due to their limited water solubility. Pregabalin is essential product to control pain and inflammation. We have synthesized novel pregabalin derivative called gabsali ((S, E)-3-(((2-hydroxybenzylidene)amino)methyl)-5-methylhexanoic acid. We have synthesized it by using salicylaldehyde to functionalize pregabalin (PG). The research was divided into two parts.

pmc-12654618.title: Microdroplet Systems for Gene Transfer: From Fundamentals to Future Perspectives
pmc-12654618.creator: Mishell Criollo, Gina Layedra, Camilo Pérez-Sosa, Gustavo Rosero, Ana Belén Peñaherrera-Pazmiño
pmc-12654618.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Microfluidics enables precise control of fluid movement within microchannels, facilitating the generation of microdroplets at high frequencies. This technology provides a unique platform for conducting biological and chemical experiments, enhancing throughput and sensitivity, particularly in single-cell analysis. The microdroplet environment enhances interactions between cells and gene delivery materials, resulting in greater contact area, higher reagent concentration, and improved diffusion for both eukaryotic and prokaryotic cells.

pmc-13114522.title: Fibre-Enriched Pasta from Wet Milled Royal Quinoa: Technological and Nutritional Characterisation
pmc-13114522.creator: Andrea Alonso-Álvarez, Claudia Monika Haros
pmc-13114522.description: Quinoa fibre-rich fraction (QFi), obtained through wet milling, represents an innovative approach to improving the nutritional and functional quality of cereal-based products. Unlike conventional whole quinoa flour (WhQF), wet milling induces phytate losses during steeping, generating ingredients with enhanced mineral bioavailability.
